neighbours.label: end of the top-ranked item in a ranking, right before 'followed by'
fire: Smoking was the leading cause of death (42%), followed by obesity (18%).
Germany produced the most cars in Europe last year, followed by France and Spain.
The kitchen was the most frequently cleaned room (12 of 20), followed by the bathroom.
Coffee is the most popular drink in the office, followed closely by tea.
Survey respondents ranked price as their top concern, followed by quality.
Brazil is the largest coffee exporter in the world, followed by Vietnam.
The knee was the most commonly injured joint (31 cases), followed by the ankle.
Python remains the most used language on the platform, followed by JavaScript.
quiet: Smoking damages the lungs (and the heart), according to most doctors.
Germany produced many cars in Europe last year, and exports grew.
The kitchen was cleaned every evening (12 of 20 days), as agreed.
Coffee is served in the office every morning, along with fresh fruit.
Survey respondents mentioned price in their comments, which surprised us.
Brazil exports coffee around the world, mostly by ship.
The knee was injured in a fall (31 days ago), and it still hurts.
Python is used on the platform for data work, and JavaScript for the web.

notes: output suppresses follow/followed: predicts 'followed by' after a ranked first item
